evidence: Temperature programmed desorption (TPD) measurements were performed on a Ga surface just after the ALE of GaAs. The desorption of atomic mass unit (amu) 29 corresponding to monomethylamine (MMA) with the formula of NCH, was observed. X-ray diffraction (XRD) measurements were used to observe the (200) X-ray diffraction peaks from AlAs films. Reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED) measurements were used to study the Ga and Al surfaces during the ALE of GaAs and AlAs. Transient quadrupole mass spectrometric (QMS) studies were performed for pulsed TDMAAs supplies while changing the substrate temperature.
